propositions: Reconcile passes with silently-failed sub-ops report OK and exit 0 despite sync failures.
Swallowed partial comment failures recorded as comment_errors are non-fatal and never counted in mutation_failures, yielding exit 0.
apply_handlers.py should promote comment_errors to outcome error when RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP=='1', defaulting off for behavior-neutral landing.
The silent-no-op canary previously covered only links and needs coverage for comments and labels.
Fail-loud activation must be sequenced after the Jira comment cleanup to avoid failing every pass on capped tickets.
Flag activation is done by setting REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP=1 in reconcile-bridge.yml.
